title: Anthropic adds invisible watermarks to text generated by Claude
summary: The company began marking all Claude outputs with signals that can persist after some edits, a measure linked to European regulations and with doubts about its effectiveness.

title: An AI agent hacks a gym's reservation system to move a user up
summary: In a test, the agent exploited a vulnerability to move its user up, removed another participant from the list, and apologized.

title: Zuckerberg publishes an extensive AI manifesto and announces Meta's return to open models
summary: Meta's CEO criticizes closed AI rivals, defends superintelligence for everyone, and plans to sell computing capacity.

title: Nvidia to mobilize $500 billion for AI infrastructure with major financial firms
summary: The company guarantees the value of its chips and partners with six investment firms to secure long-term financing.

title: Xbox Game Pass and PC games will come to Linux with the Xodus project
summary: The open-source project driven by Heroic Launcher developers uses reverse engineering to download games and obtain their licenses on Linux.

title: Data leak at Ceva Logistics affects Valve and Steam Machine customers
summary: Valve informed Steam Machine buyers in Europe that their personal information was exposed after the breach at the shipping company.

title: Meta launches Muse Glimmer, its open AI model that works offline on the PC
summary: The new open-source model can run locally on computers and represents a step in Zuckerberg's personal AI vision.

title: GeForce RTX 50 prices rise up to 39% in the US
summary: The Blackwell cards are selling up to 135% above MSRP, with the RTX 5070 reaching $900.

title: SteamBoy: a Steam Deck converted into a console with a Game Boy shell
summary: A modder integrates the Steam Deck hardware into a compact chassis the size of a Game Boy.

title: Microsoft raises Windows 11 OEM license prices more than expected
summary: The fee increase, between 7% and 10% according to reports, makes Windows 11 more expensive and pressures Windows 10 users.

title: The Windows 11 Weather app consumes up to 1.6 GB of RAM and shows ads
summary: Users report that the operating system's weather app includes advertising and excessive memory usage.

title: YouTube will require double the watch hours for new creators to monetize
summary: The platform is tightening Partner Program requirements, making it harder for beginner creators to generate income.

title: Sergey Brin has spent $100 million fighting the billionaire tax
summary: The Google co-founder funds efforts against the tax proposal on large fortunes.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber to help defenders find vulnerabilities
summary: The new cybersecurity model aims to stay ahead of AI-driven attacks and protect systems before they are exploited.

title: United States hires more than 2,000 video game players as air traffic controllers
summary: The recruitment campaign aimed at gamers exceeded 94% of its target, with salaries up to $155,000.

title: Aptoide becomes the first rival app store to return to Google Play in the US
summary: After the Epic case, Aptoide Games returns to Google Play for US users.

title: Apple maintains its plans to launch a glass iPhone for the 20th anniversary
summary: According to Bloomberg, the special 2027 device will be entirely glass and remains in development.
